decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting rests on long certification and defense procurement investments, and multi-year naval programs justify persisting despite slow visible uptake.
The spring-balanced desk lamp line has its own page and supports the ergonomic workplace positioning, so management reads modest results as a ramp-up rather than failure.
The publicly launched G2 generation of a core interior luminaire is central to the LED portfolio, and withdrawing it so soon would be hard to justify.
As the flagship of the firm's announced direction, the microprismatic pendant carries the highest public commitment, so weak results would be attributed to temporary market conditions.
HMI technology conflicts with the LED direction and is the most exposed line, but sunk certification costs and loyal maritime customers still tip management toward keeping it another year.
The marine searchlight line belongs to the robust specialist niche the firm has invested in and is kept as part of the broader marine offering.
